claims.claim: Fairly used singer sewing machine for sale!
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies an antique-style cast-iron treadle sewing machine, but brand/model is not read from the photos.
Witness notes key parts are not shown/confirmed: bobbin case/shuttle/needle/presser feet/attachments completeness is not verified.
Witness report does not confirm functionality (treadle action, handwheel rotation, timing/alignment, smooth movement).
A presser foot/needle bar area and ornate frame are mentioned, but a specific 'flat plate' component is not confirmed.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (not actually Singer) which affects demand and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model plate or any stamped markings on the head/bed (close-up, readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic antique treadle sewing machine (worst-case for brand value).

risks.risk: Missing internal parts (shuttle/bobbin case/needle/presser feet/attachments) or incomplete set.
risks.proof: A full layout photo showing all included parts laid out, plus close-ups of the bobbin case/shuttle area and presser feet/needle assembly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/not guaranteed complete set.

risks.risk: Non-functional mechanism (treadle/handwheel not turning freely, timing/alignment issues).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the treadle action and handwheel rotation while the needle bar moves, with the belt/pulley engaged and smooth motion.

risks.risk: Rust, cracks, or broken cast-iron components that reduce durability and increase repair cost.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cast-iron body, legs, and any joints/hinges showing rust level, cracks, and missing screws/fasteners.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible condition (assume higher rust/possible wear until shown otherwise).

risks.risk: Belt/pulley/bearing condition (treadle machines often need belt replacement or have worn pulleys/bearings).
risks.proof: Clear close-ups of the belt/pulley area and a video showing the belt/pulley driving smoothly without slipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming belt/pulley/bearings may need replacement.

risks.risk: Transport uncertainty (weight/size) affecting buyer cost and feasibility in Oyo.
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape (dimensions) and confirmation of approximate weight or number of people needed to lift.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher transport cost/low convenience due to unknown size/weight.

proof_requests: Send a close-up, readable photo of the brand/model plate or any stamped markings on the machine head/bed.
Show a photo of all included accessories/attachments laid out (needles, bobbins, shuttle/bobbin case, spare parts, belt, oil).
Provide close-ups of the bobbin case/shuttle area and the presser feet/needle assembly to confirm completeness.
Record a short video: treadle pumping + handwheel rotation with the belt/pulley engaged, showing smooth movement and needle bar motion.
Send close-ups of cast-iron areas (legs, joints, base) to assess rust level, cracks, and missing screws/parts.
Share approximate dimensions and weight (or at least measurements) for transport planning in Oyo.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies an antique-style cast-iron treadle sewing machine on a stand, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an unverified, potentially incomplete and untested treadle machine; key functional/brand/completeness details are not shown.
